# openwebui_terminal_server_verify (Data Source)

Asks Open WebUI to probe a terminal server and detect whether it is an orchestrator or a plain Open Terminal. The request is made by the Open WebUI server, so the URL must be reachable from there. Fails when neither probe endpoint answers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openwebui_terminal_server_verify" "dev" {
  url       = "http://open-terminal.internal:8000"
  auth_type = "none"
}

output "terminal_server_type" {
  value = data.openwebui_terminal_server_verify.dev.server_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Base URL of the terminal server to verify.

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type: `bearer` (default, sends `key`), `none`, `session` or `system_oauth`. Open WebUI only sends credentials for `bearer` when verifying.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token sent when `auth_type` is `bearer`. Sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `server_type` (String) Detected server type: `orchestrator` when `<url>/api/v1/policies` answers, otherwise `terminal` when `<url>/api/config` answers.
- `verified` (Boolean) `true` if the server answered. A failed verification is an error instead.
